panels.description: Agent task execution latency distribution over time, built from the real mae_worker_task_duration_seconds histogram buckets. Blue/green = fast executions, yellow = medium, orange/red = slow.

panels.description: OCR agent: mean processing time (purple area) + error rate (pink, right axis). Legend also reports completed/failed task counts over the range.
panels.title: OCR AGENT

panels.description: Compliance agent: mean processing time (blue area) + error rate (pink, right axis). Legend also reports completed/failed task counts over the range.
panels.title: COMPLIANCE AGENT

panels.description: Anomaly Detection agent: mean processing time (cyan area) + error rate (pink, right axis). Legend also reports completed/failed task counts over the range.
panels.title: ANOMALY DETECTION AGENT

panels.description: Reporting / aggregation agent (agent="aggregate"): mean processing time (green area) + error rate (pink, right axis). Legend also reports completed/failed task counts over the range.
panels.title: REPORTING AGENT

panels.description: Fleet-wide agent performance: mean processing time, error rate and task success rate.
panels.title: AGENT PERFORMANCE SUMMARY

panels.description: System state store. This stack uses Redis as the state store (Postgres is not deployed here, so no Postgres metrics exist to show — none are faked).
panels.title: SYSTEM STATE STORE

panels.description: Celery queue backlog (stacked depth per agent queue, left axis), unacknowledged messages, task execution rate and p95 task latency (right axis).

panels.description: API request rate and p95 latency (http_requests_total / http_request_duration_seconds).
panels.title: API HEALTH

panels.description: Redis: availability, connected clients, memory and command rate (redis_exporter).
